mentions.name: Customizable Python AST evaluation framework
mentions.description: A small Python library/framework for customising how the Python AST is walked and evaluated. It is intended to be used to configure a safe-ish sandboxed way of evaluating user-submitted expressions and code, and unlike existing alternatives it does not bake unwanted behavior into library internals.
mentions.problem: Existing libraries for sandboxed AST evaluation bake in internals the author didn't want, so a more customizable alternative is needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: A small Python library/framework for customising how the AST is walked and evaluated. I plan to use it in another project to configure a safe-ish sandboxed way of evaluating user submitted expressions and code.
